Customs

मूल्यांकन विधि

A standardized procedure recognized by the WTO Customs Valuation Agreement for determining the customs value of imported goods, affecting duty calculation and clearance.

Quick answer: A standardized procedure recognized by the WTO Customs Valuation Agreement for determining the customs value of imported goods, affecting duty calculation and clearance.

Quick answer

A standardized procedure recognized by the WTO Customs Valuation Agreement for determining the customs value of imported goods, affecting duty calculation and clearance.

Why it matters

मूल्यांकन विधि matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

What is मूल्यांकन विधि?

In this glossary, मूल्यांकन विधि refers to: A standardized procedure recognized by the WTO Customs Valuation Agreement for determining the customs value of imported goods, affecting duty calculation and clearance.

How is मूल्यांकन विधि used in logistics?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A standardized procedure recognized by the WTO Customs Valuation Agreement for determining the customs value of imported goods, affecting duty calculation and clearance.

Operational example

The transaction value was accepted as the primary valuation method for calculating customs duties on the shipment.
